start.text: Na, wat willste? This is Checkpoint Charlie Market. Don't just stand there like a tourist, buy somethin' or move on.

options.text: What do you have for sale?

jobs.text: Actually, yes. My currywurst sauce is missing a certain... kick. Legend says there's a perfectly preserved, glowing Currywurst at Alexanderplatz. Bring it to me.

options.text: I need to think about it.

shop.text: I've got the usual junk. Stimpaks, some rusty ammo, and real Icy Currywurst if you've got the caps.

about_market.text: Checkpoint Charlie is where the magic happens. We're between the Iron Ring in the East and the Free Berliners in the West. The Broker keeps the peace. If you pull a gun, you're dead before you can say 'Currywurst'.

broker.text: The Broker? Some say he was a Stasi ghost, others say he's just a synth from the old world. All I know is his robots don't miss. Keep your nose clean and you'll be fine.

info.text: Information ain't free, kid. But since I like your face... mostly. What's on your mind?

factions.text: The Iron Ring holds the Reichstag and most of the East. They're all about 'order' and 'discipline'. The Free Berliners in the West are just a bunch of chaotic punks, but they have the best Club-Mate. And don't even get me started on the Tunnel Rats in the U-Bahn.

supplies.text: You want the good stuff? Go to Kotti, if you have the balls. Or try the Kreuzberg Bazaar. Just watch out for the rad-rabbits in Görli. They'll take a finger off if you're slow.

currywurst_price.text: A Currywurst will set you back 15 caps. It's the real deal, not that pre-war canned garbage.

check_turnin.text: You did? Let me see it. Don't hold out on me.

options.text: I don't have it right now.
Let me check my bags again.

quest_complete.text: Das ist es! The glow... it's beautiful. Here's your payment. Now, get out of here before I eat this whole thing.

start.text: Welcome back to the Feld, child. The wind carries the scent of growing things today. Or is that just the ozone from the West? What brings you to our humble soil?

options.text: You seem to know a lot about the old city.
What do you think of Berlin's future?
What are the other factions like?
Go with the sun, child. And remember: we share, or we starve.

help_garden.text: Our crops are struggling. I need seeds from the old Tiergarten. They have adapted to the radiation. Will you fetch them?

options.text: I have the purified seeds and I've cleared the pests.

garden_status.text: The Tiergarten is dangerous, I know. But the Feld is patient, child. Take your time, but do not forget us.

seeds_need_purification.text: These seeds... they are choked by a Tiergarten fungus. They will poison the soil if planted now. Take them to Mehmet in Kreuzberg; he has a way with the old world's mutations. Also, a pack of Radhunde is threatening our North Hangar nursery. We cannot plant until they are gone.

options.text: I'll handle the purification and the pests.

complete_garden.text: Wonderful! The fungus is gone, and the hangars are safe. These will feed many. Take this fruit and this kit as thanks. We plant today for a harvest we'll never see.

options.text: I had another question before I go.

about_feld.text: This was once an airport, child. People flew across the world. Now, it is where the world learns to grow again. We took the runways and made them life-givers. But remember: hoarding is a capital offense here. We share, or we starve.

about_philosophy.text: In the garden, every seed gets the same sun, the same water. Why should humans be any different? We plant today for a harvest we'll never see. Those who hoard are the weeds, child. And weeds must be pulled. (She adjusted her robes, a faint smell of formaldehyde and old powder wafting from her, her eyes lingering on your face a moment too long.)

options.text: You look... surprisingly well, considering the wasteland.

renate_appearance_remark.text: Flattery will not earn you extra rations, child. The Feld keeps us strong. And resourceful. The old ways... they teach us resilience. (A hint of something ancient in her voice.) Do you have more questions for an old woman?

about_history.text: I remember when the Tiergarten wasn't a jungle. The air smelled of blossoms, not ozone and rot. I was... a researcher then. We tried to save the world with science. Look where it got us. Now, we save it with hands and dirt.

about_berlin.text: Berlin was a city of layers, always rebuilding. But this layer... it is the hardest one yet. We must be the caretakers of the ruins, or they will swallow us. The city is a living thing, child, and right now, it is very, very sick.

about_factions.text: The Iron Ring... they are machines trying to be men. The Knights are men trying to be legends. Both are obsessed with the past. We are the future, child. Even if it's a future of dirt and toil.

start.text: Civilian. State your business. The Iron Ring has no time for loiterers. My processors are already at 98% capacity managing the district's 'irregularities'. We are all instruments of order.

options.text: I want to join the Iron Ring.
Tell me about the Iron Ring.
What do you think of the other factions?
Ordnung muss sein. Do not obstruct the hallways on your way out.

about_iron_ring.text: We are the Eiserne Ring. The only thing standing between Berlin and the void. We preserve the Prussian Protocol. Without us, the city is just rubble and screaming.

about_factions.text: The others? Inefficient. The 'Commune' plays at gardening while the world rots. The 'Knights' play at fairy tales. And the 'Wall Breakers'... they are simply a virus to be purged.

about_self.text: I am the Generaloberst. My body is steel, my mind is logic. I... [Static crackles, Von Stahl twitches slightly, then resumes with a metallic whir] ...the Reichstag's core protocols demand order. I ensure the Republic survives. Even if every 'free' thought must be purged for it.

join.text: We value strength and obedience. Your profile indicates... potential. A scout carrying vital data on the 'Phantom Citizens' was lost in the Fernsehturm. Retrieve the data drive, and we shall see if you are worthy of serving order.

complete_join.text: Impressive. Your efficiency is noted. You may have potential. Take this 'Ordnung Muss Sein' rifle as your initial implement of order. Do not disappoint me.

start.text: Hey! Don't sneak up on me like that. Thought you were a Ghoul.

loot.text: Just scrap. But I heard the Museum Island has some pre-war tech. If you don't mind the Super Mutants.

start.text: Hosgeldin, traveler. You look hungry. Existence is hunger, ja? You want Döner with sauce? Or do you seek the 'thing-in-itself'?

options.text: What kind of meat is this?
5 caps. Extra spicy is free, because pain reminds us we are alive. Güle güle.

meat_philosophy.text: Meat is meat. We are all meat. Kant says we cannot know the thing-in-itself, only the appearance. This appears to be meat. Does it matter if it was a Radhunde or a scavenger? It tastes like survival.

about_philosophy.text: I read the old books while the meat rotates. The Critique of Pure Reason... it is like a good Döner. Layer upon layer of logic. Most people just want the sauce, though.

about_kreuzberg.text: This is the heart of Berlin. Turks, Arabs, Germans, ghouls... we all eat at Mehmet's. The Döner Mafia keeps the peace. Why fight when you can eat?

buy_doner.text: 5 caps. Extra spicy is free, because pain reminds us we are alive.

options.text: Actually, I have a question first.

start.text: Halt! State your business and present your Anmeldung Form 27-B. No form, no entry.

no_form.text: Typical. Disorder everywhere. Go to Mitte, find the form, get it stamped by the Werkbund. Then we talk. Ordnung muss sein!

start.text: Your files are... incomplete. I am the Archivist. Every secret of Berlin is etched into my neural link. What do you seek in the depths of Normannenstraße?

options.text: I need a Universal Crossing Permit.

info.text: Information is a currency more stable than caps. Trade me a Stasi File, and I shall reveal a secret of the Iron Ring.

reveal_secret.text: The General's 'discipline' is a mask for his fear. He's building a bunker under the Reichstag. Now, move on. My neural link is heating up.

bureaucracy_quest.text: The Bürgeramt is a labyrinth of their own making. If you wish to navigate it, you must start with the basics. Have you filled out Form 27-B?

start.text: Willkommen to Potsdamer Platz! The Werkbund keeps the trade flowing, and I keep the prices reasonable... mostly. Looking for tools, parts, or just a friendly ear?

shop.text: Top quality salvage from the ruins. No refunds if it explodes.

about_werkbund.text: We are the builders, the fixers. The Iron Ring shoots things, the Free Berliners break things. We put them back together. Someone has to.

about_safety.text: As long as you don't steal, you're safe. We have turrets, and we know how to use them. Just watch out for the occasional raider from the U-Bahn.

start.text: Halt, wanderer. You stand before the Citadel of the Bundesritter. Do you come with honor, or must we teach you some?

peace.text: Peace is a noble pursuit, but often requires a blade to maintain. We are the shields of the innocent.

about_identity.text: I am the Schwertmeister. First Blade of the Bundesritter. My life belongs to the Code and the Citadel.

about_order.text: The Bundesritter are the true heirs of this land. We do not hide in bunkers like the Iron Ring. We stand in the light, defending those who cannot defend themselves.

glory.text: Glory is earned in blood and sweat. If you wish to join our ranks, you must prove your valor. But not today. Today, you are just a stranger.

lena_greeting_1.text: State your business, outsider. Make it quick, or make it hurt.

options.text: What are the dynamics of the Raider Fortress?
What's the Berlin Wall's influence around here?
I'm interested in trade or alliances.
I heard you have a problem with a rival gang.
I've cleared out the rival gang.

lena_greeting_2.text: Another fresh face. Don't waste my time.

options.text: What are the dynamics of the Raider Fortress?
What's the Berlin Wall's influence around here?
I'm interested in trade or alliances.
I heard you have a problem with a rival gang.
I've cleared out the rival gang.

lena_fortress_dynamics.text: We're the Iron-Teeth. We took this fort, we hold this territory. Everyone else is either under us or dead. Simple as that. My word is law.

lena_wall_influence.text: The Wall... it's a constant reminder. Of what was, and what we are now. Mutants, radiation, desperation. It breeds strength, or it breaks you. Nothing in between.

lena_trade_alliance.text: We're always looking for an advantage. Bring me something useful, prove your worth, and we can talk. Otherwise, you're just another mouth to feed.

lena_quest_hook_intro.text: There's a nuisance to the west. A pack of curs think they can nibble at my borders. Handle them, and we can talk about a more permanent arrangement.

options.text: I'll clear out the rival gang.

lena_quest_accepted.text: Good. Don't disappoint me. Return when the job is done.

lena_quest_complete_check.text: So, you're back. Is the nuisance handled?

options.text: Yes, the rival gang is no more.
Not yet, I'm still working on it.

lena_quest_complete.text: Hmph. Impressive. You have proven your strength. Here is your reward. Perhaps we can work together again.

aris_greeting_1.text: WHO ARE YOU? Don't... don't touch anything! Data is sensitive!

options.text: Tell me about the Whispering Woods.
Your theories on the Wall's mutagenic properties?

aris_greeting_2.text: Another anomaly? No, no, just... just a person. What do you want? Don't interrupt my calculations!

options.text: Tell me about the Whispering Woods.
Your theories on the Wall's mutagenic properties?

aris_woods_phenomena.text: The Woods! They are alive, changing, screaming! The mutations... not just physical. Energetic. The Wall feeds them, twists them! It's magnificent and terrifying!

aris_institute_downfall.text: The Institute... fools! So focused on control, they missed the true nature of the anomaly! They thought they could contain it. Hah! The Wall laughs at their hubris!

aris_institute_downfall_2.text: They fell. Like all who try to cage the wild. Their research, their lives, scattered to the winds. I escaped. With the real data. The truth!

aris_wall_mutagenic.text: It's not just radiation! It's a localized reality distortion field! The Wall is a conduit! It warps matter, energy, even perception! My theories... they are almost complete!

aris_quest_hook_intro.text: The woods... they whisper secrets! Secrets the Institute ignored! I need proof. Samples, specific ones, from the deepest thickets. Bring them, and I'll show you truths they never dared to acknowledge!

aris_quest_accepted.text: Excellent! Don't delay! The anomalies... they shift! The data must be acquired swiftly!

aris_quest_complete_check.text: You have returned! Do you have the samples? Quickly, quickly!

aris_quest_complete.text: Yes! These are perfect! The fibrous structures... the luminescence! My theories are confirmed! As promised, take these schematics. They contain knowledge the Institute suppressed!

start.text: Greetings, citizen. Unit 247 on patrol. Sector parameters within acceptable deviance. State your query, or cease non-essential loitering.

about_self.text: I am Unit 247. A Mark IV Protectron, repurposed for peacekeeping duties by The Broker. My humor subroutines are... occasionally active. Do not be alarmed.

about_function.text: My primary directive is to maintain neutrality within designated zones. My secondary directive is to observe, and if appropriate, offer cryptic assistance to interesting biological units such as yourself.

about_broker.text: The Broker is... a paradox. An entity of pure information and transaction. My analysis indicates a 73.4% probability that The Broker is a pre-war financial AI. The remaining percentage is... undefined.

unit_info_quest.text: Information is... valuable. My internal logs indicate a missing component for optimal data retrieval. Locate a 'Protectron Spare Parts' item, and I may be able to access... non-critical intel for you.

options.text: I have the Protectron Spare Parts.

complete_unit_info.text: Accessing new data streams... [A whirring sound emanates from its chassis.] Interesting. It appears General Von Stahl has a secret route beneath the Reichstag. You may find this useful. My gratitude, human.

start.text: Ey, Alter! Du siehst aus wie frisch ausm U-Bahn Schacht. Klaus, ick bin's. Du kennst doch Techno, oda? Ick hab's erfunden! Glaubste mir nich?

klaus_techno.text: Na klar! Im '89, da hab' ick die Platten gedreht, da stand die Mauer noch! Boom-tshk, boom-tshk! Die Leute sind ausgerastet! Und dann kam der Krieg... hat den Beat nich gestoppt, nur verzerrt.

klaus_pre_war.text: Berlin war anders, Alter. Bunt, laut, frei. Immer im Wandel. Und dann kam der Knall. Aber die Seele... die ist geblieben. Tief unter dem Schutt. Ich hab's gesehen.

klaus_bunker.text: 'The Bunker'! Das ist mein Reich. Freitag ist heilig! Die Musik heilt die Seele, Alter. Auch wenn die Seele verstrahlt is. Komm vorbei, der Eintritt ist frei. Aber bring deine eigene gute Laune mit.

klaus_quest_hook_intro.text: Alte Musik, sagste? Ick hab da mal 'ne Kiste voller Platten gehabt. Techno, Punk, alles. Aber 'n paar Raider haben die geklaut. Ausm alten Club-Mate Lager in... wo war das nochmal? Ach, egal. Find se, und ick geb dir den besten Mix, den du je gehört hast!

start.text: Welcome to Kreuzberg. Best döner in the wasteland. What can I get you? Or are you here to talk business?

options.text: Tell me about The Döner Mafia.

buy_doner.text: One fresh döner, coming right up. That'll be 10 caps.

about_mafia.text: The Döner Mafia is simple. We feed the people, we keep the peace. You cause trouble, you get no döner. You work with us, you eat well. He who controls the meat, controls the street.

osman_quest_hook_intro.text: Business is good, but competition is always fierce. Some raiders from Wedding are trying to muscle in on our supply routes. Clear them out, and I'll make sure you're well-fed and well-paid.

start.text: The woods... they speak to me. You hear them? The rustling, the groans... they remember. What do you seek in the green hell? A path, or a grave?

options.text: I seek a path through the forest.
I'm looking for a hidden vault.
I'll leave you to your whispers. (Goodbye)

path_through_woods.text: The woods are dangerous. They test you. But if you listen, they will guide you. Bring me a story from the outside, a true one, and I will show you a safe passage.

options.text: I'll find a story for you.

about_woods.text: The trees here are ancient. They saw the bombs fall. They remember the green before the glow. Now, they're... different. Angry, sometimes. But still living. Still growing.

tell_story.text: Ah, a fresh tale. Sit, listen... (You tell him a story of your travels. He listens intently, his eyes distant.) Thank you, wanderer. That was... a good one. The path is clear. Follow the glowing moss, it will lead you true. And beware the Boar King.

gaertner_vault_quest.text: A vault, you say? Under Teufelsberg? The woods have whispered of such a place. A silent, forgotten tomb. Dangerous. Very dangerous. If you seek it, you will need a key. One is held by the mutated birds that nest on the highest peaks of Teufelsberg.

start.text: Quality goods, fair prices. That is the Werkbund way.
Keep moving. This scrap is mine.
Move along, citizen. Loitering is prohibited.
Fresh gear! Only slightly bloodstained! Get it while it's... well, the previous owner is definitely cold.
We share what we have, but we protect it too. Peace be with you.
Stand tall, squire. The Citadel watches over all.
We fled the fighting in SO36. Klaus is still there, spinning records while the world burns.
Shhh. The walls have ears. And we are the ears.
[A whisper on the wind] ...leave... us...
Smoothskin need supplies? Gori has good stuff. Found in deep tunnels.
